newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee closes down on U.S. attack on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee closes down on U.S. attack on Iraq.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.10 down in the kerb market at 39.28 to the dollar on Tuesday after news of U.S. missile strikes on Iraq sparked higher demand for the dollar, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open lower on Wednesday on continued dollar demand, dealer Owais Kalia said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on August 29, was 35.6200/35.7981 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 10 percent from Monday's close at 9.80 percent.
